summary: Vector Unit futuristic jet-ski racing series, moving from mobile/Windows releases to console and PC arcade racers.

entries.title: Riptide GP

emulation.emulator: Native PC / Android or iOS device
emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: Riptide GP first released on Android and later came to iOS and Windows. The Windows release has the highest output ceiling while preserving the six tracks, reverse tracks, championship events, and trick-boost racing.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release, including the itch.io download where available; use Android or iOS only for mobile-original context.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game was later made available as a free download; no remaster is sourced.

emulation.emulator: Native PC / console hardware / mobile device
emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: Riptide GP2 released first on iOS and later on Android, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Windows. Windows has the highest output ceiling and preserves the career, upgrade, trick, hot lap, elimination, and freestyle structure.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; use console or mobile versions only for platform preference.

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: Riptide GP: Renegade first released for PlayStation 4 and Windows, then reached Apple TV, Android TV, Android, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox One. Windows has the highest output ceiling and full modern feature support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release; use console versions for couch or split-screen preference.
